condition_mapping.coverage: A (recommended) follows the target-change invalidation condition when existing applicability requires comparison or the existing input itself explicitly proves target identity changed; no separate comparison flag is required. po_decision_packet.choice_A: 推奨。既存要求/profile/policy適用条件でtarget比較が適用される場合、または既存入力自体がtarget identity差（例T1→T2）を明示する場合、旧対象quarantineを新対象へ適用せず通常failure/保留へ戻す。別個の比較要求flagを条件にしない。同じpolicy scope内の再評価だけでeligibleにしない。
po_decision_packet.choice_B: 対象変更時の効果を決めず、旧sourceと条件をpreserved_pending_rehomeのまま保持する。
po_decision_packet.choice_C: 意味変更案。変更後targetへの旧receipt直接流用は拒否するが、同じpolicy scope内なら既存policy条件で再評価しeligibleになり得る。旧sourceの失効効果を弱める。
unique_oracles: A/C共通: only current run HEAD/tree provenance changes H1→H2 while target remains T1; preserve normal adopted 032 evaluation/eligible result if 032 conditions pass.
A/C共通: original run has no target input and no existing condition applying target comparison; do not require new target input or gate; evaluate 032 normally.
A/C共通: existing conditions apply target comparison but required existing target identity evidence is missing/conflicting; target-change result unknown/hold, never infer unchanged.

A/C distinction: existing input explicitly shows target identity T1→T2, even without a separate comparison-request flag; A ends old quarantine applicability and T2 is normal failure/hold; C may newly evaluate T2 under existing policy conditions.
po_decision_packet.difference_and_impact: A follows NFR-16 expiry on an identified target change when existing applicability requires comparison or the existing input itself explicitly shows the target difference. C changes that effect by allowing same-policy reevaluation within scope. Neither A nor C treats HEAD/tree provenance alone as a target change, requires target comparison for ordinary 032 runs with no target input/applicability, or changes adopted 032 baseline/current distinction. Missing evidence blocks only where existing conditions apply target comparison. Impact is HELIXOS-L2/L11-128 target-comparison interpretation; 032 bytes/authority, policy-wide revoke, cancellation/rollback, and implementation permission remain unchanged. A separate reading that every HEAD/tree is a target would expire quarantine on each commit/tree change and narrow 032 normal eligible cases; legacy source does not define or adopt this reading.
